crossRefs.note: Ahab said, “By whom?” He said, “Yahweh says, ‘By the young men of the princes of the provinces.’ ” Then he said, “Who…
Then he mustered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty-two. After them…
So these went out of the city, the young men of the princes of the provinces, and the army which followed them.

people.name: Ben-hadad
people.line: King of Aram, contemporary of Asa and Baasha.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”
translations.bsb: And the young officers of the district governors marched out first. Now Ben-hadad had sent out scouts, who reported to him, “Men are marching out of Samaria.”
translations.kjv: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Benhadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.
translations.asv: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben-hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out from Samaria.
